capabilities: Overlay heading markers on the edge of the note
Hover the marker strip to reveal heading labels
Click markers or labels to jump to headings
Customize marker shapes, colors, fonts, and hierarchy display
Set minimum and maximum heading levels to show
intentEvidence: Marker strip overlaid directly on the note, no sidebar panel needed.
motivation: The author wanted a modern, beautiful outline displayed directly in notes rather than in a side panel.
problem: Obsidian's outline lives in a sidebar panel, so quick heading navigation takes up screen space instead of sitting on the note itself.
summary: Minimap outline that overlays heading markers on the note's edge, with hover labels and click-to-jump heading navigation.
